verdict.rationale: The skills ship as SKILL.md folders, and the docs say a single SKILL.md can be pasted into any chat to run outside Claude Code, which suggests some portability. But the pack never claims conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, and the install paths are Claude-specific (.claude/skills/, the /plugin marketplace). Missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, frontmatter/structure details, evidence of the folder loading in non-Claude agent tooling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling

citations.quote: No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`
